turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Hey [PERSON_1], how's it going?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Hi [PERSON_2]. Pretty good. How are you?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I'm doing well, thanks. It's been a busy couple of weeks on my end, but nothing too crazy. How's everything in Sioux Falls?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: We got our first snow last night. Just a dusting, but it's officially here.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Already? That feels early.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: It is a little early, but honestly I'd rather have snow than the wind we had all last week. My commute was brutal.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Fair enough. So I wanted to check in on the training session we've got on the calendar for November 10.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Yes, that's still on. Six new hires starting that Monday, so the timing works well.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Good. Do you know who all needs logins set up before then?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Let me pull up my list. I've got the six names here. I can send them over this afternoon.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That would be great. Once I have the list, I'll get the logins created so everyone's ready to go on day one.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Perfect. Three of them are coming from our call center in Fargo, so they'll need the same access as the rest of that team.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay, I'll note that. Same permissions as the Fargo group.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Right. The other three are local here in Sioux Falls.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Got it. And are you planning to run the session, or do you want me to lead it?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I was hoping you could take the first part, the overview stuff, and then I'll walk them through our day-to-day workflows.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That works. I'll put together a refresher version of the overview, nothing too long. Maybe thirty minutes?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Thirty minutes is good. Their attention spans are short on day two.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Ha, understood. I'll keep it tight. Do you want me to send a calendar invite to the group, or should I send it to you and you forward it?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Send it to me and I'll forward it. Some of them don't have their work email set up until their first day.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: No problem. I'll get that out by end of week.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Thanks. Now, holiday call volume. I'm expecting the usual spike around Thanksgiving and then again the week between Christmas and New Year's.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That lines up with what I usually see. Do you want to adjust anything on your end for that stretch?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: We're adding a couple of extra shifts, mostly on the outage side. Nothing we can't handle.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Okay. If anything changes, just let me know and we can look at it together.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Will do. Honestly, last year was fine, so I'm not expecting surprises.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Good to hear. How's the rest of the team doing?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Everyone's good. We had a team lunch last Friday, which was nice. First one we've done in a while.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That sounds fun. Anything good on the menu?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Just pizza. But it was the good pizza place, so no complaints.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Can't go wrong with that. Oh, how's the new puppy?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Oh, he's a terror. Chewed through a phone charger already. But he's cute, so he gets away with it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: What kind is he?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: A lab mix. My daughter picked him out. She's been begging for a dog for two years, so here we are.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That's how it always starts. Well, congrats. Or condolences, one of the two.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Both, honestly. But he's settling in.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Glad to hear it. Anything else on your radar before the holidays?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Not really. Things are going fine, just the usual busy season stuff.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Good. Then I'll send the invite by Friday and get the logins ready once I have your list.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Perfect. I'll get you those names today.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Sounds good. Talk soon, [PERSON_1].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Thanks, [PERSON_2]. Have a good one.
